Class Schedule

This page contains a schedule of the topics, content, and assignments for the semester. Note that this schedule will be updated as necessary as the semester progresses, with all changes documented here.

Instructions to save the slides as PDFs can be found here. The key is to hit E when the slides are open in your browser (ideally Chrome, but it may work in others) to toggle into PDF print mode.

Readings can be accessed using the link (when needed, through the Cornell library with a Cornell login) or on Canvas.

TipHow To Read This Schedule
  • Homework go out on the day listed and are due at 9:00pm on the Friday listed. The solution key posts one day after the due date, when the late window closes.
  • Quizzes take the first 25 minutes of the session listed. A quiz never covers material from the same week — everything through the previous Friday is fair game, and nothing after it.
  • Readings are due, with annotations and reflection, by the start of the first lecture the following week.

Assessment Schedules

The deadlines above are listed in full, with what each one covers, on their own pages:

  • Quiz schedule — dates, coverage, and what is on a quiz
  • Homework schedule — dates, structure, and when each solution key posts
  • Project schedule — mini project and term project deliverables
